title: CeNita Winery Tasting Room
gap: Price for wine tastings not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings in the Original Tasting Room, Dock’s Place Tasting Room, or on the Vineyard Lawn while soaking in views of Yonah Mountain. The winery produces handcrafted red and white wines grown in the foothills of Yonah Mountain. CeNita also serves as a wedding venue with outdoor vineyard ceremonies and reception spaces overlooking the mountains.
extraNote: Tasting rooms or Vineyard Lawn at 591 Dock Dorsey Rd, Cleveland, GA
